name: Rutgers Spring 2018

venue.name: [Rutgers University](https://www.rutgers.edu/)
venue.address: 84 Joyce Kilmer Ave, Piscataway Township, NJ 08854

information: This competition will serve as a fundraiser for the Rutgers Chapter of Alpha Kappa Psi, the Co-Ed Professional Business Fraternity. Funds will go toward the Rutgers Dance Marathon – an event that aims to raise money for the Embrace Kids Foundation that benefits families and children affected by cancer, sickle cell, and other diseases. There is a flat fee of $25 and a competitor limit of 200. Refunds will not be granted and walk-in competitors will not be permitted, no exceptions.
